text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-P3221, Decorative Fleur De Lis Door Pull Plate 3" Wide x 18" High

This gorgeous door push plate features the popular Fleur de Lis design at both ends, as well as patterned edges with incredible detail.

This push plate is sand cast in the traditional style of the 1800's, the design is taken from Louis XVI School of Architecture c.1774-1792 featuring the ever popular fleur de lis which, for centuries, had stood as a symbol of the old French monarchy.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available: Fleur De Lis Push Plate

Specifications for Brass Accents A04-P3221 Decorative Fleur De Lis Pull Plate

  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Height: 18"
  • Pull Handle Length: 11-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2.25"
  • Material: Solid Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
